notes: Consumption ab web aur mobile par EK hi record hai — doosri dafa add nahi hoga. Mobile par din bhar tank bhejte jayein, aakhir mein upar ⋮ menu se Save kar dein to plan final ho jata hai aur list se ghayab ho jata hai; tabdeeliyan History se hongi. Ghalat record delete karne par stock khud wapas ajata hai. Returned Tanks ki list, tank clear (basket) aur har tank ke saath us ke plan ka number bhi shamil hai.
releaseNotes: Consumption finalize/single-record guard pack + OUT-tank transfer menu fix + Returned Tanks screen/list pack: one shared consumption record per plan on web and mobile (delta-only posting, delete reverses stock exactly); Flashy FG Consumption header menu with Save (finalize) + History; finalized plans leave the dropdown; OUT tanks show no Transfer entries and open a view with add-materials + Return Weight/Save; Returned Tanks lists every leftover tank with weight and origin plan number, shiftable to active plans; tank-prep basket button clears the prep and credits stock back; tank cards/rows show their plan number.
